prompt: Finance, investment and fintech events in New York, September 2026 — curated for Pascal AI Labs

events.name: FinovateFall 2026
events.location: Marriott Marquis Times Square, New York
events.description: 60+ live fintech product demos, 2,000+ senior decision-makers. AI, embedded finance, open banking, digital banking. One of the densest fintech audiences in the US.

events.name: Global Volatility Summit 2026
events.description: 300+ senior investment professionals from pension funds, insurance, endowments, family offices — representing $35T+ AUM. Ideal for Pascal AI Labs targeting large allocators.

events.name: Global Alts New York 2026
events.description: iConnections x Managed Funds Association. 1,000+ institutional allocators and fund managers in curated 1:1 meetings, panels, and keynotes. High-quality LP/GP audience.

events.name: Private Debt Investor New York Forum 2026
events.description: PEI flagship North American private credit conference. 200+ LPs alongside senior credit managers and allocators. Covers direct lending, CLOs, distressed, and structured credit.

events.name: Hedgeweek US Summit 2026
events.description: Hedge fund leaders roundtables on capital raising, investor engagement, operational scaling, regulation, and disruptive technologies including AI. Curated senior audience.

events.name: Venture Capital World Summit New York 2026
events.location: Workspace by Rockefeller Group, New York
events.description: VC pitching sessions, panels, and networking for Series A-stage companies and international growth businesses. Access to VC decision-makers in a focused one-day format.

events.name: AFIRE Annual Member Meeting 2026
events.description: Annual executive conference for real estate leaders and institutional investors. Draws senior allocators from global pension funds, sovereign wealth, and insurance with real estate mandates.

events.name: ACI Digital Assets: Compliance & Regulatory Forum 2026
events.description: Government officials, crypto firms, exchanges, and legal experts on digital asset compliance and enforcement. Growing crossover with traditional finance AI/data use cases.

events.name: NYU Stern PEVC Conference 2026
events.description: PE and VC-focused academic conference drawing practitioners, fund managers, and limited partners. Strong networking with mid-market and emerging manager community in NYC.

events.name: New Private Markets Investor Summit North America 2026
events.description: PEI summit focused on next-generation private markets investing — infrastructure, real assets, private credit, and co-investments. LP-heavy audience from endowments and family offices.
